description: This file declares the RuntimeManagerHandler class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, which manages runtime lifecycle events and notifications for applications, including initialization, control commands (run, kill, terminate, suspend, resume, hibernate, wake), and event handling. It also defines an internal notification class for runtime events.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerHandler
classes.description: Manages application runtime lifecycle events, controls, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerNotification
classes.description: Implements the IRuntimeManager::INotification interface to handle runtime events such as start, terminate, failure, and state changes, and forwards these events to the parent RuntimeManagerHandler.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the runtime manager with the provided service and event handler.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the runtime manager, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts or resumes an application with specified parameters and target state.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Terminates the application instance identified by appInstanceId.

methods.name: hibernate
methods.description: Puts the application instance into hibernation.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Wakes the application instance and sets its lifecycle state.

methods.name: getRuntimeStats
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics for the specified application instance.
